Text: Clare knows every one of her 212 Year 9s by name and, more usefully, by what each of them needs. When she rebuilt our morning check-in, attendance moved within a term and stayed moved. She is ready to lead a curriculum, and I would say so to anyone.

Sheffield at Work is the best unit our department teaches, and Clare wrote it around a full timetable. Eleven schools now use it. She plans backwards from what a thirteen-year-old will actually remember, which is rarer than it should be.
Clare mentored me through my first two years. She watched my worst lessons without flinching and gave me one thing to change each week, never five. I still plan the way she taught me.
A hidden recommendation. The importer must leave this one out.
